title: Staff Platform Engineer — stealth AI infra (Series B)
text:
We're a world class, fast paced team looking for a 10x ninja / rockstar who will disrupt infrastructure.

You will:
- Design Kubernetes clusters and Kafka pipelines at global scale
- Own Terraform, AWS, GCP, and Azure (yes all three)
- Ship GraphQL and gRPC gateways
- Mentor across Java, Spring, and Django monoliths we still run
- Unlimited PTO. Synergy. Come build the future.

Must have: Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Java, Django, GraphQL.
Nice to have: MCP, Playwright, TypeScript.

Apply if you live and breathe distributed systems.
